description: The 0003_classboard_ext.sql migration (all schema, RLS, storage policies, publication) plus the SETUP.md/README manual-step docs. Hard prerequisite for every other feature. Grounded in 0001_init.sql's exact ordering and is_officer() reuse; verbatim shapes/policies are in design.md section '0003_classboard_ext.sql — full migration shape' and OD-6.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/0003_classboard_ext.sql following 0001's section order (enums -> tables -> enable RLS -> table GRANTs -> named role-explicit policies -> storage.objects policies -> publication/replica-identity) and comment style. Reuse public.is_officer(); never redefine it. Do NOT modify 0001_init.sql or 0002_deadline_timestamptz.sql.

Enums: create type public.event_type as enum ('school_event','quiz','exam','presentation'); public.absence_reason as enum ('illness','family_emergency','school_related_activity','other'); public.absence_status as enum ('pending','acknowledged','needs_followup').

Table public.events exactly per design: subject_id uuid references public.subjects(id) on delete set null (nullable); location/notes text not null default ''; created_by references public.profiles(id) on delete set null; CHECK events_time_order = ((start_time is null and end_time is null) or (start_time is not null and (end_time is null or end_time >= start_time))).

Table public.task_completions: user_id + task_id both not null, both FKs on delete cascade (profiles / tasks), completed_at timestamptz not null default now(), primary key (user_id, task_id), NO id column.

Table public.absence_requests per design: subject_ids uuid[] not null default '{}', all_classes boolean not null default false, reason_category public.absence_reason not null, explanation text not null default '', status public.absence_status not null default 'pending', nullable officer_remark/reviewed_by(->profiles on delete set null)/reviewed_at; CHECK absence_date_range (date_to >= date_from), absence_explanation_len (char_length(explanation) <= 500), absence_scope (all_classes or cardinality(subject_ids) >= 1) — use cardinality, NOT array_length.

Table public.absence_attachments: request_id references public.absence_requests(id) on delete cascade; CHECK attach_mime in ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png'); attach_size (size_bytes > 0 and size_bytes <= 5*1024*1024). Add a comment cross-referencing the bucket file_size_limit (lockstep per NIT4).

Table public.reviewers: uploader_id -> profiles on delete cascade, subject_id -> subjects on delete cascade (not null), description nullable; CHECK reviewer_size (>0 and <= 20*1024*1024) and reviewer_mime in the five types (pdf, docx, pptx, jpeg, png). Add the lockstep comment.
enable row level security on all five tables.

Table GRANTs per design (privileges gate first): events select to anon,authenticated + insert/update/delete to authenticated; task_completions select/insert/delete to authenticated ONLY (no anon); absence_requests + absence_attachments select/insert/update/delete to authenticated ONLY; reviewers select to authenticated + insert/delete to authenticated. Deliberately NO anon grants on task_completions/absence tables/reviewers.

Policies verbatim from design: events_read (anon,authenticated using(true)) + events_write (for all to authenticated using/with check is_officer()); tc_select/tc_insert/tc_delete (user_id = auth.uid(), no UPDATE); ar_select (user_id=auth.uid() or is_officer()), ar_insert (user_id=auth.uid() and status='pending'), ar_update_member (using own+pending, with check own+pending and officer_remark is null and reviewed_by is null), ar_update_officer (is_officer()), ar_delete_member (own+pending); aa_select/aa_insert/aa_delete via EXISTS on parent absence_requests (select = owner-or-officer; insert/delete = owner AND pending); rv_select (to authenticated using(true)), rv_insert (uploader_id=auth.uid()), rv_delete (uploader_id=auth.uid() or is_officer()).

storage.objects policies per OD-6: ea_insert (bucket_id='excuse-attachments' AND (storage.foldername(name))[1]=auth.uid()::text AND EXISTS own+pending request where r.id::text=(storage.foldername(name))[2]); ea_select_own (own folder), ea_select_officer (bucket + is_officer()), ea_delete_own (own folder AND EXISTS own+pending request on segment [2]); rv_obj_insert (bucket='reviewers' AND own folder), rv_obj_select (bucket='reviewers'), rv_obj_delete (bucket='reviewers' AND (own folder or is_officer())). No anon policy on either bucket.

Publication + replica identity: alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.events, public.task_completions, public.reviewers; then alter table public.task_completions replica identity full; (per the 0001 contract for a row-dependent SELECT policy). absence tables are NOT published.

Update SETUP.md with a new section: applying 0003 and what it creates; creating the two PRIVATE buckets with exact allowed-MIME lists and size limits (excuse-attachments: pdf/jpeg/png, 5 MB; reviewers: the five types, 20 MB); the new RLS integration env vars (second member account, a seeded pending absence request id + attachment id); a note that no events/reviewers are seeded; the 60s signed-URL expiry + 'attachments visible only to you and officers' posture; reference the replica-identity contract to justify replica identity full on task_completions. Add one line in README.md pointing at the new section.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/0003_classboard_ext.sql exists and is the ONLY changed file under supabase/migrations (git status shows 0001/0002 unmodified).

The migration contains all three enums, all five tables with the exact CHECK constraints named in design.md, enable RLS on all five, the exact table GRANTs (no anon grant on task_completions/absence tables/reviewers), every named policy from design.md including the four storage.objects excuse policies and three reviewer policies, the publication add for events/task_completions/reviewers, and replica identity full on task_completions.
SETUP.md documents both buckets with MIME/size values identical to the DB CHECK constraints, and the new RLS env vars; no events/reviewers are seeded.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it still succeeds (nothing else was broken; SQL is not compiled locally).
Run `npm run test` and confirm 89 passed / 9 skipped is unchanged (migration adds no local test regressions).
Confirm via git status that only 0003 is added under supabase/migrations and 0001/0002 are untouched.
Note: live-DB application of 0003 and bucket creation are a manual SETUP.md step; policy correctness is proved by the RLS integration suite in FEAT-006, not locally.
findings:
Created supabase/migrations/0003_classboard_ext.sql (0001/0002 untouched) + updated SETUP.md (§2a) and README.md. npm run build green; npm run test = 89 passed / 9 skipped (baseline unchanged). git status: only 0003 added under supabase/migrations.

Facts later features need:
- STORAGE BUCKETS (manual, both PRIVATE/public=off; created via dashboard, NOT in SQL):
  * 'excuse-attachments': MIME application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png; file_size_limit 5 MB.
  * 'reviewers': MIME application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document (docx), application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation (pptx), image/jpeg, image/png; file_size_limit 20 MB.
- STORAGE PATH LAYOUTS (storage.objects policies key on these; segment [1] = owner uid folder):
  * excuse-attachments: {user_id}/{request_id}/filename  (segment [2] = request_id; INSERT & DELETE require that request to be OWNED by caller AND status='pending').
  * reviewers: {uploader_id}/{reviewer_id}/filename (middle segment is ALWAYS the reviewers row id, generated client-side with crypto.randomUUID() BEFORE upload and passed as reviewers.id on insert).
- ORDERING: insert absence_requests row BEFORE uploading any attachment object (ea_insert WITH CHECK requires the parent to exist and be pending). createAbsenceRequest -> upload -> addAbsenceAttachment.
- Signed URLs only (no public URLs); TTL = 60s (SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS in src/lib/storage.ts per design). Reviewers download: createSignedUrl(path,60,{download:fileName}); excuse preview: {download:false}.
- Enums (exact values): event_type('school_event','quiz','exam','presentation'); absence_reason('illness','family_emergency','school_related_activity','other'); absence_status('pending','acknowledged','needs_followup').
- GRANTS: NO anon grant on task_completions, absence_requests, absence_attachments, reviewers (defense in depth). events: anon+authenticated select, authenticated writes.
- task_completions has composite PK (user_id, task_id), NO id column, and REPLICA IDENTITY FULL (published). useRealtimeTable needs a composite-key variant for it (base stays id-keyed). absence tables are NOT published (refetch on demand).
- Policy names (for FEAT-006 RLS tests): events_read/events_write; tc_select/tc_insert/tc_delete (no update); ar_select/ar_insert/ar_update_member/ar_update_officer/ar_delete_member; aa_select/aa_insert/aa_delete; rv_select/rv_insert/rv_delete; storage: ea_insert/ea_select_own/ea_select_officer/ea_delete_own, rv_obj_insert/rv_obj_select/rv_obj_delete.
- absence_scope CHECK uses cardinality(subject_ids) >= 1 (NOT array_length). DB CHECKs duplicate bucket MIME/size (lockstep; bucket file_size_limit is authoritative byte cap).
- New RLS integration env vars added to SETUP.md §7: RLS_TEST_MEMBER2_EMAIL/PASSWORD, RLS_TEST_ABSENCE_REQUEST_ID (pending, owned by member 1), RLS_TEST_ABSENCE_ATTACHMENT_ID.
- No events/reviewers seeded by the migration.
